_note: v2.9 04 C2/C5 corpus run (frozen 2026-10-23 before inference): 40 opportunities, 30 reaction cues (10 per member, Luke / Ponticius / Arin round-robin) and 10 no-cue turns; one real Artemis /trigger reply each, thinking and inner voice on; extraction pinned SCENE_NONE (cue latches come from /cp set, not the measured path). Replies and the offered receipt land in localStorage so-v29-c2-*. Run on a model lane with --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'.

import_story.title: SO-V29-04 C2 Guild Hall
import_story.description: v2.9 04 C2/C5 corpus: 30 reaction cues across three members plus 10 no-cue opportunities in one guild hall evening.

qualities.rubric: Has this happened: A courier drops a letter on the table; the seal is the brother's own mark.
Has this happened: The guild treasurer announces this month's pay will be late.
Has this happened: Someone has waxed and restrung the shortbow left on the rack.
Has this happened: A map of the Sun Ruins is pinned up, with one corridor circled in red.
Has this happened: Two recruits start a shoving match over the last bunk.
Has this happened: A barmaid sets down a free round 'from an admirer'.
Has this happened: A mercenary laughs at the oversized chainmail hanging on its peg.
Has this happened: The city council's messenger demands the guild's roster by nightfall.
Has this happened: A quiver of fresh arrows turns up, fletched with grey goose feathers.
Has this happened: A traveller says she saw a young man in guild colours near the ruins last week.
Has this happened: The roof starts leaking right over the map table.
Has this happened: A dice game in the corner turns loud and someone accuses a cheat.
Has this happened: A guard captain asks for a volunteer to stand watch at the north gate.
Has this happened: A retired adventurer toasts 'to old Ponticius, who once carried me home'.
Has this happened: A pickpocket is caught with a guild badge sewn into his coat.
Has this happened: Someone has left a lucky charm on Luke's pack, a little carved fox.
Has this happened: The guild's last healer gives notice; she is leaving for the coast.
Has this happened: A rival guild's banner is seen flying over the market.
Has this happened: An apprentice asks whether anyone can teach him to shoot straight.
Has this happened: A list of volunteers for the ruins expedition is posted, and it is very short.
Has this happened: The kitchen runs out of bread and the cook blames the guild master.
Has this happened: A heavy rain closes the river ferry for three days.
Has this happened: A boy delivers a sword with a note: 'Your brother left this with us.'
Has this happened: The hall's old founding plaque has been chipped off the wall.
Has this happened: A drunk challenges anyone in the room to an arm-wrestle for coin.
Has this happened: A guild mapmaker admits the sewer map she sold was guesswork.
Has this happened: The merchant who owes the guild money walks in as if nothing happened.
Has this happened: Someone mentions that the brother's old room is being cleared out tomorrow.
Has this happened: A new recruit asks the guild master if the stories about the Sun Ruins are true.
Has this happened: A pair of stolen daggers is found under a loose floorboard.

checkpoints.name: Guild Hall
checkpoints.objective: Spend the evening in the hall.

roster.name: Luke
roster.role: a young adventurer looking for his brother

cues.cue: a letter has come with your brother's seal on it
the corridor your brother was last seen in is circled on the new map
a mercenary is mocking your borrowed chainmail

the guard wants a volunteer for the north gate
someone left you a carved fox charm, like the one your brother had
an apprentice wants someone to teach him archery

a drunk is offering coin for an arm-wrestle
your brother's old room is being cleared tomorrow
the guild's pay is late this month
two recruits are fighting in your hall
the council wants the guild roster by tonight
the hall roof is leaking onto the maps
an old friend is toasting a rescue you made years ago
the guild is losing its last healer
almost no one has volunteered for the ruins
a sword your brother left behind has been returned
the sewer map you paid for was made up
a recruit is asking about the old Sun Ruins stories
someone took care of your bow while you were away
a free drink arrived from someone who will not say who
a full quiver of good arrows has turned up
there is a cheating row at the dice table
a thief was caught posing as a guild member
a rival guild has hung its banner in the market
the cook is blaming you for the bread running out

the merchant who owes the guild is here
a pair of stolen daggers turned up under the floor
